audit_phase: Phase 4 - Architecture, Engineering Quality & Operational Readiness

architecture.evidence: Clean Architecture layer boundaries audited. Domain decoupling in realtime_explainer.py verified. Fast heuristic attribution distinguished from full KernelExplainer.
architecture.remediation_completed: ENG-0002 decoupled direct infrastructure imports from app/domain/realtime_explainer.py and clarified SLA-path heuristic attribution.
architecture.remaining_work: Long-term migration of remaining RedisStore callers to AsyncSession repositories.

configuration.evidence: Pydantic BaseSettings audited with single source of truth across .env, .env.example, and docker-compose.yml. Fail-fast production invariant validator implemented.
configuration.remediation_completed: ENG-0004 implemented Settings.validate_production_invariants() rejecting insecure placeholders in production mode.

security.evidence: Audit across secrets and security defaults completed. Zero hardcoded secrets in source code. AES-GCM / HMAC-SHA256 zero raw PII guarantees verified.
security.remediation_completed: ENG-0003 eliminated static fallback password probing across redis_store.py, cache.py, main.py, and redis_listener.py.
security.remaining_work: Formal external third-party penetration test prior to live banking traffic.

persistence.evidence: PostgreSQL 16 AsyncSession + SQLite local dual-engine verified. Redis persistence truthful: durable when connected, explicit in-memory ephemeral when offline.
limitations: In offline/single-process mode without Redis, state is held in-memory and does not survive cold restarts.
persistence.remediation_completed: RedisStore thread-safety and bounded storage guarantees implemented.
persistence.remaining_work: Provision persistent Redis cluster for multi-worker container deployments.

concurrency.evidence: Shared fallback store locking verified under 8-thread concurrent stress test without dictionary mutation errors. Stop events bounded to prevent leaks.
concurrency.remediation_completed: ENG-0001 added threading.RLock() synchronization across all RedisStore fallback operations.

background_jobs.evidence: Background simulation worker threads managed with threading.Event cancellation, thread pool isolation, and WebSocket progress broadcast.
limitations: Simulations run as background threads within web process; for high-volume enterprise clusters, Celery/RabbitMQ worker separation is supported via configuration.
background_jobs.remediation_completed: Bounded stop event tracking added in simulation router.

observability.evidence: OpenTelemetry tracing hooks, structured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics endpoints, and tenant-isolated logging verified.

health_readiness.evidence: /health and /health/ready endpoints provide truthful separation of liveness, readiness, and dependency degradation (503 when Redis/Postgres unready).

frontend.evidence: React 19 SPA architecture verified. 356/356 Vitest unit tests passing across 86 test suites. Production bundle builds cleanly in 13.20s without compilation errors.
frontend.remediation_completed: Verified zero TypeScript, JSX, or bundling errors.

api_contracts.evidence: OpenAPI schemas, Pydantic v2 validation models, and TypeScript types synchronized. Consistent HTTP error status codes and error envelopes.

dependencies.evidence: Python 3.12 / uv package management and npm package locks verified. Zero vulnerable dependencies identified in active execution paths.

containers.evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for backend (Python 3.12 non-root) and frontend (Nginx 1.27) verified. Docker Compose manifests include health checks and network isolation.
limitations: Local execution environment lacks Docker daemon; manifests statically verified via test_docker_manifests.py.
containers.remediation_completed: Manifest syntax, port parity, and health checks validated.

ci.evidence: GitHub Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) covers Ruff linting, backend tests, frontend Vitest, production build, and security scans.
ci.remediation_completed: Verified CI workflows execute all unit and integration gates.

testing.evidence: Comprehensive test suite: 3,745 backend pytest tests + 409 verification tests + 356 frontend tests + 11 smart contract tests = 4,521 passing tests.
testing.remediation_completed: Added test_engineering_hardening.py verifying concurrency, fail-fast production configuration, and domain isolation.

documentation.evidence: Comprehensive documentation across README.md, docs/ (architecture, system design, engineering decisions, deployment guide), and audit dossier.
documentation.remediation_completed: Reconciled engineering decisions with Phase 4 hardening changes.

reproducibility.evidence: Fresh-checkout workflow verified. Dependencies install via requirements.txt and package.json without undeclared global tools.
reproducibility.remediation_completed: Documented end-to-end reproducibility protocol in reproducibility_report.md.

external_integrations.evidence: Kafka, Redis, and SGX hardware enclave dependencies degrade gracefully and fail truthfully when unconfigured or absent.
limitations: SGX hardware attestation runs in explicit software emulation mode when hardware enclaves are physically unavailable.
external_integrations.remediation_completed: Truthful degradation verified across all integration layers.
